title: HHRCS Detection Sidecar
description: Per-clip sidecar written by detector.py at trigger time. classification field is null on write; populated by speciesnet_pass.py on Mac.

clip_path.description: Absolute path to the Pi camera H264/MP4 recording. Null until recording is confirmed written.

session_id.description: Recording session identifier, matches clip_id at trigger time

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the first trigger detection fired

ended_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the detector session ended. Null if session still active.

trigger.description: The single detection that crossed threshold and started recording

model_version.description: Identifier matching the ONNX file used

bbox.description: Normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in original frame coordinates

frame_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the frame in which the trigger was detected

detections.description: Per-frame detection records accumulated across the clip duration

oneOf.description: Populated by speciesnet_pass.py — never written by the Pi

species.description: Binomial or higher-rank taxon name at the level SpeciesNet returned (e.g. 'odocoileus hemionus' or 'cervidae')

common_name.description: English common name if available at the returned taxonomic level

taxonomic_level.description: Taxonomic rank of the returned prediction. Stored at whatever level SpeciesNet returned — no forced species-level.

prediction_source.description: Component that produced prediction, from SpeciesNet output (e.g. 'ensemble', 'classifier', 'geofence')

model_version.description: SpeciesNet model version string from output

classified_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when speciesnet_pass.py wrote this block

raw_predictions.description: Top-N SpeciesNet predictions before geofencing, for audit
